question: I want to see the future of Zoro at age 40 and 60 as well! From Captain Nobuo
answer: If he lives on without any major problems, I think it would be something like this * Age 40: Yontoryu (Four Sword Style) Zoro * Age 60: Gotoryu (Five Sword Style) Zoro A future where “something” happens * Age 40: I’m quitting.
